recorded.letter:
**PRIOR AUTHORIZATION DETERMINATION**

**Decision: APPROVED**

**Service:** Continuous Glucose Monitor  
**Order Date:** April 16, 2025  
**Patient:** [Patient Name]

---

Your prior authorization request for a continuous glucose monitor has been **APPROVED**.

**Criteria Met:**

**Diabetes Diagnosis:** Confirmed. Patient has active diabetes mellitus with Hemoglobin A1c of 6.1% documented February 9, 2025 (obs-002).

**Medical Necessity:** Confirmed. Patient is on insulin therapy—insulin glargine 22 units at bedtime, initiated May 24, 2024 and currently active (med-003).

**Recent Practitioner Visit:** Confirmed. In-person diabetes follow-up visit with Dr. K. O'Neill on October 30, 2024, within the required timeframe (168 days prior to order). Visit documentation shows review of glucose log and HbA1c, assessment of diabetes control and hypoglycemia risk, and discussion of continuous glucose monitoring (doc-005).

The patient meets all coverage criteria for continuous glucose monitor therapy.

---

**Authorization Details:**  
Please reference this determination when submitting claims. Contact us with questions.
